column1: # imagegen-styles.tsv -- the imagegen style inventory (design:
# docs/research/2026-09-11-imagegen-integration.md s3/s6).
# One data row per style:
#   style-id<TAB>aspect<TAB>size-pair<TAB>seed<TAB>prompt-template<TAB>negative-template<TAB>lora-slot
# aspect is intent shorthand; size-pair (WxH) is what every API consumes.
# seed is the per-family continuity pin: same style suffix + same seed +
# same checkpoint = reproducible art (design s3).
# The negative-template and the (optional) lora-slot column are inert on the
# --free pollinations leg (keyless GET takes no negative field); they feed the
# local ComfyUI leg when it goes live.
# The empty lora-slot column is optional on data rows: a missing 7th field
# reads as empty (edit tools strip trailing tabs), and the driver parses
# NF>=6 accordingly.
# Style framing note: the Nihei / Hayashida / Matsumoto flavor is carried by
# style descriptors (high-contrast monochrome ink, brutalist architecture,
# negative space, fine cross-hatching, desaturated), never by artist names in
# prompts. Per-artist prompting is a legal-and-quality gray zone (design s3
# "style-approximation framing"); the descriptors below approximate the
# shared aesthetic denominator instead.
